name: Cygnet Desk
tagline: The CRM for wedding pros who'd rather shoot the day than chase the deposit.
positioning: Cygnet Desk is a booking, contract, and follow-up CRM built for solo wedding photographers, florists, and planners who run the whole business alone.

hero.h1: Book the wedding. Skip the spreadsheet purgatory.
hero.sub: Cygnet Desk handles inquiries, contracts, invoices, and the 14 follow-up emails you keep forgetting — so you can go back to actually being good at your job.

features.title: Inquiry to signed in one thread
features.description: Every question, quote, and PDF contract lives in one conversation. No more digging through your inbox at 11pm looking for the venue address.

features.title: Follow-ups that nag for you
features.description: Ghosted after a consult? Cygnet pings the couple on a schedule you set, politely, so you never have to write the awkward 'just circling back' email again.

features.title: Contracts couples actually sign
features.description: Send a branded proposal with e-signature and deposit request attached. They tap once, pay, and you get your Saturday back.

features.title: Timeline that survives the day
features.description: Build the wedding-day schedule, share it with the couple and second shooter, and update it live when Aunt Linda runs 40 minutes late.

features.title: Money you can see coming
features.description: Track deposits, balances, and who owes what across every booking. Know your next three months before your accountant does.

features.title: One brand, zero apps
features.description: Ditch the six subscriptions. Email, invoicing, scheduling, and files in one place that doesn't look like it was built in 2009.

testimonials.quote: I booked eleven weddings last spring and answered every inquiry in under an hour. Before Cygnet I lost couples because I replied Tuesday. It's embarrassing how much this helped.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: The follow-up automations closed two bookings I'd fully written off. It's basically a polite version of me that doesn't get discouraged.
testimonials.name: Marcus Bell

testimonials.quote: My couples sign contracts from their phones and the deposit hits before they've closed the tab. I stopped chasing payments entirely, which was 90% of my personality.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

pricing.blurb: For the one-person operation doing everything but the catering.
For pros in peak season who never want to lose an inquiry again.
For the solo act quietly running a small empire of weddings.

homepage.footerBlurb: Cygnet Desk keeps the paperwork of wedding season off your plate so the only thing you're winging is the toast. Built for one-person shops.
